Name: Visual Crossing Sprite Overhaul
Author: K2sync
Description:
[b][center][size=2][i](Note: Farmer sprite may return as needing to update because of NPC version change. 2.0 IS coming.)
[/i][/size][size=4] 
[img]https://64.media.tumblr.com/894b1bede00b6e791ceea51bc0202e8b/55da525e3a8f7524-33/s400x600/9405f86a075bf7c75936a38e3e11da679c219201.png[/img]﻿

[img]https://66.media.tumblr.com/32a1d929b105dde11f08331c4a101f1a/a946edea84b0d6be-70/s400x600/0785f1420cf1a6a78fe3b8b67a8a7c3a28773dfb.png[/img]﻿[/size][/center][/b]A complete redraw of very nearly all the characters in the game so they look like their portraits, for a more immersive gaming experience, including alternate designs and a polished Farmer model that comes with a full range of new hair and shirt styles.

Best practice is to use with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4615/]Visual Crossing Portrait Overhaul[/url], but features sprites specifically for use with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4745]DCBurger.[/url]

If you have a suggestion for an alt or an error to report, please do!

﻿[size=5]Install[/size][list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].

[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Install Content Patcher[/url].

[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].

[*]Run the game using SMAPI.

[/list]Comes with further instructions.
